title: 1990 Donruss All-Star Game #697 Mark McGwire Oakland Athletics Baseball Card
categoryName: Sports Mem, Cards & Fan Shop:Sports Trading Cards:Trading Card Singles
descriptionText:
This 1990 Donruss All-Star Mark McGwire sports trading card features the iconic baseball player in his Oakland Athletics uniform. With a card size of standard, this original card is made of card stock material and is licensed by the Major League (MLB). It is a great addition to any sports trading card collection and is perfect for fans of the Oakland Athletics.

This card is not autographed and is part of the 1990 Donruss set. It has a card number of 697 and is an original parallel variety from the All-Star Game. Manufactured in the United States by Donruss, this card is a must-have for any collector or fan of Mark McGwire.
